messages:
marc: Heads-up team 10:00am PT next Thurs were cohosting with CloudMart + EdgeBox. Producer (Streamline) needs final speaker list + 1-slide bios by Tue EOD. Also need to confirm whether the demo uses on-prem EdgeBox or hosted CloudMart endpoint. Agenda + assets: https://drive.example.com/cloud-edge-cohost

anna: Added. I'll collect bios. Quick Q: can we ship any batteries with demo kits? Legal flagged lithium-Ion rules for the venue.

devon: No batteries in checked kits. EdgeBox has a local power module that needs DC lead only. We'll include instructions for local power hookup.

talia: I can own swag logistics. Partner wants small merch (lanyard + postcard). For APAC customs lanyards are fine; postcard counts as printed matter.

samir: Streaming notes  captions vendor wants an RTMP stream + a 128kbps mono channel for speech. Also request to pin a static slide at start for 30s for MC.

ops-bot: Reminder: Producer call scheduled Tue 11:00am PT in #zoom-pro-producer. Meeting link posted in calendar.

marc: Important  one speaker (CloudMart PM) had a flight rebook and requested remote participation from Bangalore. Can we rearrange timing to make Q&A friendly for IST folks?

anna: We can move Q&A later by 15 mins. Proposed new run order below. Thoughts?

devon: Run order looks good. For the live demo: I'll use EdgeBox local with model-v2-q8; backup plan is CloudMart-hosted with private routing token. I'll test cold-start at 10:00am Mon.

marc: Proposed run order:
```
1) 09:55 Pre-roll & sponsor slide
2) 10:00 Intro (marc)
3) 10:05 CloudMart keynote (remote)
4) 10:18 EdgeBox demo (devon)
5) 10:33 Panel Q&A (anna + partners)
```

talia: For swag: can we print a QR postcard that doubles as a lead-gen card? Marketing needs final QR asset by Wed noon.

samir: For analytics, please point QR to shortlink https://rwd.io/cloudedge so we can attach UTM. I'll add to analytics doc.

anna: Speaker bios list: I've got CloudMart PM, EdgeBox Eng Lead, and our Solutions Architect. I'll add 1-line and headshots to the folder.

devon: AV checklist for demo station: EdgeBox unit, ethernet (cat6), 2x power C13, local monitor with DP, HDMI adapter, USB mic. Also bring spare SATA-to-USB for logs.

ops-bot: Note: Venue prohibits external SIM modules. WiFi credentials will be provided day-of at 08:30.

marc: Streaming fallback: Streamline will record locally and we can splice in pre-recorded demo if connectivity drops. Please produce a 90s canned demo clip and upload to folder.

talia: Customs: for EU shipments we need commercial invoice + HS 8473 and declare 0 lithium battery content. I'll add templates to the shipping folder.

devon: Tech issue earlier this week: EdgeBox firmware 3.2.1 had an NVMe mount bug causing model load failures. Confirmed fixed in 3.2.2. I'm provisioning all kits with 3.2.2 image.

marc: Who will MC? We need a single on-stage voice to coordinate partner handoffs and moderate chat.

anna: I can MC if Marc can join live for partner intros. Otherwise Sophie from marketing offered to jump in.

samir: Security note: don't embed full routing tokens in slides. Use a short-lived guest token and store it in secure doc. I'll generate token and drop link to keyring.

devon: I'll do a dry-run Wed 09:30am PT at the venue to validate monitor mapping and latency to hosted endpoint. Will post results here.

marc: Great. Please upload final deck + bios by Tue EOD, shipping manifest by Wed morning, and confirm MC by Wed noon. Any blockers call them out here. :shipit:
